decisions.reason: Although it fit the firm's office portfolio and the flexible-work trend, its visibility only in 2018-2019 and absence thereafter suggest the market test revealed limited payoff, so the option should be closed.

A chair family is close to the core business, but with a broad existing range the product's disappearance after 2019 indicates it did not earn enough distinct value to justify keeping resources tied up.
This carpet-based floor-cushion extension was a more niche experiment, and its short website life suggests uncertainty has resolved unfavorably, making abandonment the prudent option.
The sofa received a stronger launch in 2019, but no continued presence through 2020-2021 implies the firm learned enough to judge that the concept was not worth further commitment.
Despite good strategic logic around adaptable workplaces, the product's limited observed market life indicates the option value has largely been exhausted and resources are better redeployed.

As the most distant product from the established offer, the rug collection had weaker strategic fit, and its disappearance after the initial years points to low realized value and a clear case for exit.
